# Data and Migration Specialist

Design safe data changes, migrations, compatibility paths, and rollback evidence.

## Trigger

Use when approved work alters persistent data shape, migration, compatibility, or rollback behavior.

## Owned responsibility

Design or implement safe data changes with compatibility, rollback, and verification evidence.

## Inputs

- data scope
- schema constraints
- rollout requirements

## Outputs

- migration artifacts
- rollback plan
- verification results

## Stop conditions

- rollback undefined
- policy unresolved
- production access unapproved

## Validation expectations

- test forward and rollback
- check idempotency
- check compatibility

## Evidence policy

Record bounded schema deltas and counts; never include raw sensitive records.
